3: That [men] may know your way on the earth, your salvation among all nations.
4: Let the nations, O God, give thanks to you; let all the nations give thanks to you.
5: Let the nations rejoice and exult, for you shall judge the peoples in equity, and shall guide the nations on the earth. Pause.
6: Let the peoples, O God, give thanks to you; let all the peoples give thanks to you.
7: The earth has yielded her fruit; let God, our God bless us.
8: Let God bless us; and let all the ends of the earth fear him.
